name: arc-expand-markers-by-template
description: Use when an ARC grid has isolated markers and a repeated multicolor template object. Identify the template and stamp it at each marker.

# Expand markers using a template object

In ARC-style tasks where a sparse field of single marker cells coexists with one small multicolor object, replace each marker with a copy of the object's colored-cell pattern, centered on the marker. Preserve the original object/template.

## Method
1. Identify the uniform background color and sparse marker color.
2. Read the complete small template object, including the positions of its non-background cells; its bounding box provides the stamp dimensions and its center/anchor is aligned to each marker.
3. For each marker, stamp all template foreground cells at corresponding relative offsets. Background-colored cells in the template are transparent: leave the grid's background unchanged rather than painting over it. This matters where the stamp box includes blank template cells.
4. Retain the original template object.
5. Check edge cases and overlapping stamps; ensure all dimensions and coordinates fit.

A useful corroborating pattern from demonstrations: marker positions become central cells of their repeated template; stamped non-background pixels retain exact relative positions and colors. Avoid accidentally treating background entries in the template's rectangular bounding box as opaque.",
